moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-layout-word-insert, written here): Sentence 30 px with one slot word (last word or [bracketed]): slot = word + 7 px pad each side, 1.5 px accent outline, radius 6, inside a card (radius 8). Swaps at 0.4 / 2.0 / 3.6 s (recipe every 2–3 s): slot width tracks the new word on a spring k 300, c 30 (ζ≈0.87); following text and card move with it. In the slot (clipped): old word exits up 0.7 × slot height with fade, 0.25 s power2.in; new enters from 0.7 × below with fade, 0.35 s expo.out. Loop 5 s. Params: lò xo (k 300, c 30) · nhịp đổi (1.6 s) · vào (0.35 s) · ra (0.25 s).
